text.en:
While on Stasis Subclass:
Barricade is replaced by a Stasis Wall.

The Stasis Wall is 5 medium crystals wide. The middle crystal is a small crystal.
Stasis Wall lasts 14 seconds.

Inherits Rally Barricade Cooldown and Bonuses. Functions even if no crystals remain.
text.ko:
시공 하위직업을 장착했을 때:
방벽이 시공 수정으로 변환됩니다.

시공 수정 방벽은 7개 중간 크기 수정으로 이루어져 있으며 중앙은 작은 수정입니다.

시공 수정 방벽은 집결 방벽의 효과를 부여하지만 수정이 3개 이상 파괴되면 기능을 잃게 됩니다.

Barricade is replaced by a <stasis/>Stasis Crystal Wall that lasts 14 seconds. <stasis/>Stasis Wall is made of 4 Medium Crystals and a Small Crystal in the middle.

While a <stasis/>Stasis Super Ability is equipped:
Barricade is replaced with a <stasis/>Stasis Crystal Wall.

The <stasis/>Wall is made of a Small <stasis/>Crystal in the middle and 2 Medium <stasis/>Crystals on either side of it.

Applies Rally Barricade benefits to players standing behind the middle <stasis/>Crystal for 14 seconds, even if destroyed. Overrides Class Ability Cooldown with Towering Barricade's.

While a <stasis/>Stasis Super Ability is equipped:
Barricade is replaced with a <stasis/>Stasis Crystal Wall.

The <stasis/>Wall is made of a Small <stasis/>Crystal in the middle and 2 Medium <stasis/>Crystals on either side of it.

Applies Rally Barricade benefits to players standing behind the middle <stasis/>Crystal for 14 seconds, even if destroyed. Overrides Class Ability cooldown with Towering Barricade's.

While a <stasis/>Stasis Super Ability is equipped:
Class Abilities are replaced by a <stasis/>Stasis Crystal formation.

When used with Rally or Towering Barricade:
• Spawns a <stasis/>Stasis Crystal Wall made of a Small <stasis/>Crystal in the middle and 2 Medium <stasis/>Crystals on either side of it
• Grants Rally Barricade benefits to players standing behind the middle <stasis/>Crystal for 14 seconds, even if destroyed.
• Overrides Class Ability cooldown with Towering Barricade's

When used with <arc/>Thruster:
• Spawns 2 Medium <stasis/>Crystals diagonally forward to either side of you
